steps.en: Clone it into your agent's skills folder and install the scripts' two npm deps
steps.zh: 克隆到 agent 的 skills 目录，装好脚本的 npm 依赖

steps.en: Invoke the skill and answer onboarding: daily or weekly, time zone, language, delivery channel
steps.zh: 调用 skill，回答引导问题：日报或周报、时区、语言、推送渠道

steps.en: Once a day, the author's GitHub Action pulls new X posts, podcast transcripts and blog posts into feed JSON
steps.zh: 作者的 Action 每天抓 X 帖子、播客转录和博客，写成 feed

steps.en: Ask your agent for the digest — or let the OpenClaw cron job fire it
steps.zh: 让 agent 出一期简报——或交给 OpenClaw 定时任务触发

steps.en: Fetches the central feeds plus the latest prompt files as one JSON blob, no API keys
steps.zh: 拉取中央 feed 和最新 prompt，合成一份 JSON，无需 key

steps.en: Your agent rewrites it per the prompts, one source link per item, in EN, ZH or bilingual
steps.zh: agent 按 prompt 改写成摘要，每条附原链接，中文、英文或双语

steps.en: Sends it to Telegram or email, or just prints it in the chat
steps.zh: 推送到 Telegram 或邮箱，或直接在对话里输出

value.en: A short cited digest of what a fixed list of AI builders said — you stop scrolling X and podcasts to find it
value.zh: 一份附原链接的 AI 建造者动态简报——不用再自己刷 X 和听播客
